title: Baggo catalog manifest
description: A whole catalog in one file: identity, version, categories and items. Images are the only external resource. This schema is the FORMAT — what any catalog may be. The stricter house rules this repository holds itself to (a locale map for every name, all five shipped locales, 1024x1024 JPEG photos) live in scripts/validate.py, because a fork is entitled to publish one language and no photos at all.

schema_version.description: Shape of this file. 2 is the single manifest; 1 was the root/list/categories split. A client that does not understand a higher number imports what it can rather than refusing the catalog.

id.description: This catalog's permanent identity, chosen by the author and never changed. Reverse-DNS is recommended: uk.baggo.official. Baggo identifies an installed catalog by this — not by URL, not by filename — so the same catalog fetched from a mirror, or imported from a file, is still the same catalog. An item's identity is (this id, its slug).

name.description: What the user sees in the catalog list, and on the screen that asks them to approve this catalog.

version.description: Bumped on every publish. Clients compare this integer — not a tag, not a date — to decide what to re-read.

description.description: One or two sentences about what is in here. Shown before the user installs it.

homepage.description: Where a user reports a problem with this catalog.

license.description: How the catalog's data may be reused. An SPDX identifier or a URL.

default_locale.description: The locale a client falls back to when a name has no entry for the app's language. Absent means the first entry in the map.

expires.description: How many days a client may go before re-checking a URL catalog. Absent means 7.

categories.description: Ordered: array order is display order, and the app seeds shelf rank from it.

icon.description: One of Baggo's icon names. An unknown or absent icon falls back to the default category icon and is reported as a warning, never as a failure.

category.description: A slug defined in this manifest's categories. An item whose category does not resolve is skipped and reported; the rest of the catalog still imports.

unit.description: One of Baggo's unit names. Unknown or absent means no unit.

image.description: Item photo: an absolute https:// URL, or a path relative to THIS manifest's own location. Absent means the category's icon is shown. The path may be declared before the file exists.

localizedText.description: Either a plain string — language-neutral, shown as written whatever the app's language — or a map of locale code to string. No locale is mandatory: a client uses the app's language, then default_locale, then the first entry.

anyOf.description: a map of locale code to string
a .jpg, .jpeg, .png or .webp path relative to the manifest, with no leading slash and no walking upwards
